adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `updateAllCalendarEvents`, the code was updated to treat `calendarReference` as an array (`filter(...)`) and loops over all `_calendar` references to update them. However, in the reschedule-merge cleanup block (`if (newBookingId)`), it still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, which selects only the first calendar reference. With multiple calendar references now possible (e.g., collective/team bookings), this would delete only one old calendar event and leave stale events on other calendars.
